description: Agent Operations: submit prior agent answers (each question, the answer given, when, and its basis or source where recorded) with the policy or source change that supersedes part of their basis, as the old and new text of each changed section or a stated change description. The signed report flags every answer whose basis the change touches, quotes the superseded basis, and marks each flagged answer stale or unaffected with the reason. Supplied material only: comparing two full policy versions is wever_terms-change-check. Verdict stale_answers, touched_but_current or none_touched. POST /api/answer-freshness-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-operations-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-operations/.

basis.description: The policy or source text the answer relied on, where recorded.

source.description: The policy, page or section the answer cites.

description.description: The change as stated, such as "The refund window is now 14 days, down from 30."

sections.description: Old and new text of each changed section.

new_text.description: The section after the change; empty when it was removed.

source.description: The policy or source that changed.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

name: wever_answer-freshness-check
title: Answer freshness check
